title: LG V40 lock screen reading delay
symptom: On an LG V40 running Android 8.1.0, the lock screen BG value is not updating; it stays on a value until the collector is restarted, while other displays show the current value.
cause: The problem is likely not a bug in xDrip but rather Android's handling of the always-on lock screen, which may be delayed or stuck.
evidence_quote: The problem does not reside in the lock screen itself, but in the _always on_ lock screen. Although the BG value in the notification on the lock screen is updated, the _always on_ lock screen value is either delayed, or stuck on 6.8, which seems to be the default value. I don't think this is a bug in xDrip, but rather Android.
